review.finding: engines >=22.12 is looser than vitest's own range (^22.12 || ^24 || >=26): odd releases 23 and 25 pass the check. npm only warns, so this has no practical effect.
review.suggestion: Optionally mirror vitest's range. [Implementer: kept the plain minimum, which the reviewer rated acceptable.]

review.finding: The tightest margin is branches (87.66%, 7.66 points above the gate), not functions.
review.suggestion: Cite branches in the ADR. [Implementer: corrected in the ADR and PR text.]

notes: The flat shape is the vitest 5 Thresholds API, and with perFile defaulting to false it applies to the global totals; it was confirmed in the type definitions that 'global' was a glob key. CI measures the same file set with the same locked versions. netlify.toml sets no Node version, so Netlify now picks up 22 from .nvmrc, which is compatible. There is no .npmrc, so engines only produces a warning. The deploy scripts have no Node-22-specific dependency.
